title: Jade Compass: Relics, Whales, and Dawn
summary: In a world sculpted by bias and unfitting relics, a lone jailer's ornament hinted at a tormented ontology. A young woman, guided by a cracked jade compass, began her journey, escaping a soupy wetland where finches took liftoff from a derelict taxi. Her path led through a tranquil fjord, past oafish monkeys, towards a mythic haven. But barbarous forces and overcooked warnings from her matriarch threatened to derail her. Decked for battle, she faced an astonishing extension, confronting colossal, incarnate whales. Amidst damaging artillery and geeky lawyers, she bluffed her way through. Eventually, cheating the razing, she found herself in a rowboat at dawn. A sympathetic headmaster's eclectic prediction, jazzing with kinks, had come true. She had turned the tide, illuminated by the jeweled light of a new day.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
